one_liner: Ranks every number by its appearances, each older one counting for less, halving after about 4 draws (a month).
registry_status_reason: Revision 1 installed for review and not yet released (E2R-R58): IN_DEVELOPMENT.txt is present and no SUPPORTED entry exists.
short_explanation: E_9 looks at each number on its own. It adds up every past appearance of each number, with each draw counting 5/6 as much as the one after it, so an appearance loses half its weight after about 4 draws (a month). It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 1 earlier draw. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
